apps.name: Andarium
apps.subtitle: Android on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Andarium runs the Android system on iPhone and iPad. It is built on the Kernarium runtime, which runs a real Linux kernel natively and emulates only the code of the apps, with graphics drawn through Metal.

It needs iOS 26 or later. With a free Apple ID, Android gets less memory. JIT is optional and experimental.

versions.localizedDescription: Root access with Magisk, Android's system libraries translated ahead of time, 120 Hz on ProMotion devices, Add to Home Screen, VoiceOver support, and more.
